## ResourceNullabilityResult.parentsScanned property

How many parents the probe looked in for items: the parents whose child collection's length it read, empty or not. 1 for a top-level collection. For a nested resource this can be fewer than all the parents: see `PARENT_SPREAD` and `MAX_PARENT_VISITS`<!-- -->.

**Signature:**

```typescript
readonly parentsScanned: number;
```
